Day 13 data are critical. A physical apparatus change (mass, pivot, damping) would show as a sustained level shift with normal scatter; a calibration or procedure error might show as either sustained shift or further drift. This measurement will consume minimal time and directly addresses the apparatus-design-confusion hypothesis (p=0.14), which blocks all downstream interpretation.
